The '''''Victory II''-class Star Destroyer''', also known as the '''''Victory II''-class Destroyer''', or '''''Victory Cruiser''''', was an improved version of the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]]. The ''Victory II''-class was a more direct predecessor to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Victory_class_over_dac.jpg|180px|thumb|150px|left|A ''Victory II''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in battle.]]

Though outwardly similar to the ''Victory I''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''Victory II''-class was designed for deep space combat.
With this in mind, the designers fitted the ships with [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]] engines in place of the ''Victory I's'' [[LF9 ion engine]]s to overcome weaknesses of the earlier design. Where the LF9 ion engines could not produce sufficient acceleration to engage faster and newer vessels in ship-to-ship combat, the new drives were far more powerful and added significantly to the newer ship's sublight speed and maneuverability.<ref name="ISB" />

Besides its faster sublight speed, the most notable change was the addition of [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], more [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam projectors]], and the removal of the banks of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] tubes. The ''Victory II''-class, however, did retain its predecessor's ability to operate within planetary atmospheres.<ref name="SOTG01" />

==History==
''Victory II''-class Star Destroyers were used late in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> but still produced early enough in the conflict to receive Republic livery.<ref name="DL:TRODV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>The class would still see production after the conclusion of the conflict,<ref name="SOTG07" /> but was not built as extensively as the ''Victory I''-class.<ref name="ISB" />

The ''Victory II''-class Star Destroyers were used as patrol and blockade starships, as well as having main duty serving as [[Sector/Legends|sector]] patrols. They were sent out in pairs or with other ships, regularly moving into areas of suspected [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] or [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] activity to pacify the sector.<ref name="ISB" /> Other ''Victory II's'' were used for deep space interdiction missions, using their ion cannons to capture enemy starships without damaging them. These vessels were often assigned to missions where the capture of the target was required for information gathering purposes. As they carried only two [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], the ''Victory-II'' would often be deployed in the company of fleet [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]] or escort ships that carried a large number of starfighters for quick deployment.<ref name="SOTG07" />

Mostly seen as inferior to the more powerful ''Imperial''-class ships, some thought that the ''Victory''-class would be decommissioned following the newer design's entry into service. The growth of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] eventually would lead the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to keep the ships in service as they needed every available [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] for duty.<ref name="SOTG01" /> At the beginning of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Alliance seized several of them, but they were all presumed to have been lost or recaptured.<ref name="AOR:CR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> Some ships would eventually see service with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="X:IR" /> Others would remain in use by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], with at least one, the [[Protector (Victory II-class)|''Protector'']], seeing action during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] at the [[Battle of Borosk (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Borosk]].<ref name="FH:R">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>
